```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
OH <- read.csv("C:\\Huy Phan\\College\\VoterTurnout\\Exploratory_DA\\ready_data\\OH.csv")
WA <- read.csv("C:\\Huy Phan\\College\\VoterTurnout\\Exploratory_DA\\ready_data\\WA.csv")
```


```{r}
df1 <- OH %>%
  mutate(
    primary_margin = abs(dem_primary_total - rep_primary_total) / (dem_primary_total + rep_primary_total),
    general_margin = (dem_general_total + rep_general_total - dem_primary_total - rep_primary_total) / 
                     (dem_general_total + rep_general_total)
  )

# Remove invalid or extreme values if needed

# Plot
oh_plot <- ggplot(df1, aes(x = primary_margin, y = general_margin)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary Margin (Competitiveness)",
    y = "Non-Primary Share of General Turnout",
    title = "Non-Primary Voter Share of General Turnout of OH",
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("OH_turnout_plot.jpg", plot = oh_plot, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
oh_plot
```


```{r}
df2 <- WA %>%
  mutate(
    primary_margin = abs(dem_primary_total - rep_primary_total) / (dem_primary_total + rep_primary_total),
    general_margin = (dem_general_total + rep_general_total - dem_primary_total - rep_primary_total) / 
                     (dem_general_total + rep_general_total)
  )

# Remove invalid or extreme values if needed

# Plot
# Create and save plot for WA
wa_plot <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = primary_margin, y = general_margin)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +

# Save plot

wa_plot
```

```{r}
df_long_party <- OH %>%
  mutate(
    dem_primary_share   = dem_primary_total / (dem_primary_total + rep_primary_total),
    dem_general_share   = dem_general_total / (dem_general_total + rep_general_total),
    rep_primary_share   = rep_primary_total / (dem_primary_total + rep_primary_total),
    rep_general_share   = rep_general_total / (dem_general_total + rep_general_total)
  ) %>%
  select(dem_primary_share, dem_general_share, rep_primary_share, rep_general_share) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    party  = if_else(str_detect(type, "dem"), "Democrat", "Republican"),
    phase  = if_else(str_detect(type, "primary"), "Primary", "General")
  ) %>%
  drop_na(share)

```

```{r}
ggplot(df_long_party, aes(x = share, fill = phase)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ party) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Vote Share (Two-Party)",
    y = "Precinct Count",
    fill = "Election Phase",
    title = "Histogram of Vote Share for Each Party in OH",
    subtitle = "Comparing Primary vs. General"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
